preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The number of columns m is between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The total number of cells is at least 2.
The maximum number of different types of squares k is between 1 and 4 inclusive.
The number of lines in the map is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in map)
preconditions.description: Each row in the map has a length of exactly m.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzST' for c in row) for row in map)
preconditions.description: Each character in the map is a lowercase Latin letter or 'S' or 'T'.
There is exactly one starting square 'S' in the map.
There is exactly one terminating square 'T' in the map.

postconditions.expression: stdout in ['-1'] + [''.join(path) for path in valid_paths]
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' if no valid path exists, or a lexicographically minimal path from 'S' to 'T' represented as a sequence of plot types.
